purpose: Teach: 教頭/推し進め/確証/製本/スキャナ/試験場/防火/配色

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、教育機関の教頭先生と懇談しろ
lines.en: Go have a discussion with the vice-principal at the educational institution we're working with.
lines.style: Direct, clipped authority. No preamble. Each phrase distinct and weighted. A task being assigned, not debated. Steady eye contact level.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業を推し進める準備を整えました
lines.en: Understood. I've completed the preparations to move the new business initiative forward.
lines.style: Measured, professional clarity. Slight formality in the register — reporting up. Even tempo, confident but not eager. Brief pause before the summary.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、確証のない投資は控えろ
lines.en: And make sure the company avoids investments without solid evidence backing them.
lines.style: Firm instruction layered under a cautionary tone. Weight on 'avoids.' Not lecturing — reinforcing a principle. Cool, deliberate pacing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社史の製本作業を進めております
lines.en: Understood. We're currently proceeding with binding the company history documents.
lines.style: Formal status report tone. Slightly procedural in rhythm. Respectful, thorough — the voice of someone tracking multiple ongoing tasks.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、書類のスキャナでの電子化を急げ
lines.en: Accelerate the digitisation of company documents through the scanning system.
lines.style: Sharp, immediate urgency. Cut through the syntax. No softening. The command lands and expects motion. Slight lean forward in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員研修を試験場の様式で実施します
lines.en: Understood. I'll be implementing the staff training sessions using the examination format structure.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact confirmation. Professional precision — showing he's understood the directive and has a plan. Even, unflustered delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社内の防火設備を点検しろ
lines.en: Inspect all the fire safety equipment throughout the company.
lines.style: Decisive, non-negotiable. Crisp edge on 'inspect.' Safety matters — this one carries weight behind the brevity. Direct, no room for reinterpretation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新ロゴの配色を確定しました
lines.en: Understood. We've finalised the colour scheme for the new logo.
lines.style: Calm closure. A task checked off. Clean, satisfying finality in the tone. Slightly warmer than previous updates — this one is done.
